title: Proper coherent sections separated by all infinitesimal quotient projections
statement: Let $A$ be Noetherian, complete for $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], let $J$ be the ideal sheaf of $I$ on $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, and let $p:Z\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $F$ be coherent on $Z$ [pqf-def-coherent]. For any $A$-module $M$ and maps $a,b:M\to\Gamma(S,p_*F)$, if for each $n\geq0$ their composites with $\Gamma(p_*\pi^F_{n+1})$ into $\Gamma(S,p_*(F/(J\mathcal O_Z)^{n+1}F))$ agree, then $a=b$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module].

source.place: Degree zero: injectivity of the canonical sections map to the inverse limit

proof.text: Define the natural isomorphism t between sections of pushforward over A and globalSectionsFunctor on Z followed by restriction along GammaSpecIso inverse composed with p.appTop. Its underlying additive-group map is identity, and scalar compatibility and naturality both hold by rfl. Apply globalSections_formalFunctions_complete_base to obtain the canonical isomorphism e with all quotient projections.

Cancel the monomorphism t(F).hom followed by e.hom. Apply limit.hom_ext and write an index as op n. Replace e.hom followed by that projection using its equation. Naturality of t rewrites both expressions as a and b followed by the pushed-forward quotient map and t on its target. Postcompose the given equality at n with that t component.

theorem proper_complete_quotient_sections_jointly_monic
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [IsProper p]
    (F : CoherentModules Z) {M : ModuleCat.{u} A}
    (a b : M ⟶ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F.obj))
    (hab : ∀ n : ℕ,
      a ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap p) (n + 1) F.obj)) =
      b ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap p) (n + 1) F.obj))) : a = b
